bandsReadTheScore: Score bands read the form score only: put bands on a number rule under From rules
tierMappingHelpText: A yes/no rule gives at least its tier when it fires, e.g. a knock-out to Critical. A number rule places the vendor in bands, like the form score.
tierHighestWins: When several apply, the highest tier wins.
searchVendorOrDomain: Search a vendor or a domain
tiersFedByNone: No form assigns criticality tiers yet. Load the Vendor tiering library, or turn on “Assign the vendor's criticality tier” on one of your forms in the library builder.
noTierResolved: No tier could be worked out from this response
bandsOrMappingRequired: Add score bands, a rule, or both
bandsOutcomeNotNumeric: Bands under From rules must read a number rule of the form
thresholdMinRequired: Every band but the last needs a minimum score
thresholdsMustDescendByRank: Bands must go from the most to the least critical tier
thresholdsMustDescendByMin: Minimum scores must decrease from one band to the next
mappingOutcomeUnknown: A row points at a rule the form does not have
subjectModelMismatch: The form's subject question must point at the right kind of object
showProjection: Show the projected result to respondents
showProjectionHelpText: While filling the form, respondents see what accepting it would set, e.g. the vendor's tier. Leave it off for forms sent to the vendor itself.
projectionPending: Answer the questions to see it
invalidExpressions: Some rules cannot be evaluated, so the draft was not saved. Fix them and save again.
outcomeRuleIdDuplicate: Another rule already uses this ID
outcomeRuleIdInvalid: Use letters, digits and _, not starting with a digit
tierHidden: Uses a hidden tier: accepting would set a tier that is no longer on the scale
tierSetupInvalid: The tier setup is out of order: bands must go from the most to the least critical tier, with decreasing minimums.
builderUsePageScoreHint: Fills the expression with the score of that page, computed as set on the page (sum, maximum or average).
onSubmitApplies: Submitting applies the result directly, no review needed.
onSubmitGoesToReview: Submitting sends it to a reviewer before anything is changed.
alwaysReviewHelpText: Even when the person submitting could make the change themselves, a reviewer accepts it before anything is written.
tierInHistoryCannotDelete: This tier appears in the tier history. Hide it instead.
